scope: control-plane identity only; no Slurm or production-policy mutation

stage_1.only_change: append one immutable LOOK V5 request journal
stage_1.monitor_action: replace the pending finalizer one-for-one with an immutable monitor allowing exactly the base and generated LOOK-only policy SHAs before installing the LOOK-only policy

stage_2.only_change: Models control plane appends its Uncertainty_Lab journal
stage_2.monitor_action: if still pending, replace the stage-1 monitor one-for-one with an immutable monitor that also allows the exact newly frozen Models policy SHA before installing that policy

v21.source_derivation: requires the exact v20 source SHA, replaces exactly the legacy journal anchor and policy allowlist, and rejects changed anchors
v21.successor_journal: all later GPU successor appends use the dedicated V5 journal registered by stage 1
v21.handover: submit replacement held, verify exact afterany identity, cancel old pending monitor, verify terminal, then release; every boundary is durably receipted
v21.crash_recovery: an exact held replacement is rediscovered by the immutable spec before any new submission
v21.stage2_running_rule: wait for a running stage-1 monitor to become terminal before installing a Models policy that it does not accept

open_gate: Independent review, an Ibex CPU shadow using fresh scontrol identities, and account-lock deployment are required; production remains unchanged.
